description: nf-core/scrnaseq samplesheet context JSON template aligned to the current nf-core/scrnaseq usage documentation. Designed for LLM-friendly parsing and conversion into the main pipeline CSV and any required companion CSVs.

pipeline.name: nf-core/scrnaseq
pipeline.core_rule: The first 3 columns must be sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. Additional columns may follow for optional or mode-specific inputs.

cellranger_multi_barcodes.required_when: Using cellranger-multi with multiplexed FFPE/CMO/OCM data

pipeline.multi_run_behavior: Rows with the same sample value are treated as multiple runs/libraries for the same sample and concatenated before downstream analysis.
pipeline.pairing_behavior: The pipeline expects paired FASTQ inputs in the main samplesheet examples; filenames should match except for R1/R2 where applicable.
pipeline.protocol_note: Protocol/chemistry is set via the --protocol pipeline parameter, not as a standard samplesheet column.

validation_rules: First 3 columns of the main samplesheet must be exactly: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2.
The pipeline input file must be comma-separated (CSV).
Use the same sample value across rows for multiple lanes/runs of the same biological sample.
fastq_1 and fastq_2 should point to gzipped FASTQ files ending in .fastq.gz or .fq.gz.
For standard paired FASTQ inputs, filenames should only differ by R1/R2 as a sanity check.
expected_cells must be an integer when provided; if a sample spans multiple rows, keep the same value on each row.
seq_center must stay consistent across repeated rows of the same sample if used.
Add feature_type only for cellranger-multi inputs; allowed values are gex, vdj, ab, crispr, cmo, beam (beam currently unsupported).
Add sample_type and fastq_barcode for cellranger-arc inputs; sample_type should be gex or atac and fastq_barcode is usually populated for atac rows.
When using multiplexed FFPE/CMO/OCM data with cellranger-multi, also prepare the companion barcodes CSV.
FFPE, CMO, and OCM are mutually exclusive within a single cellranger/multi sample.
Additional context columns for LLM workflows may be appended after official columns, but remove or validate them before strict pipeline execution if necessary.

main_samplesheet.description: Primary nf-core/scrnaseq input CSV. Works for standard runs and can be extended for cellranger-multi or cellranger-arc with conditional columns.

sample.description: Custom sample name. Reuse the same value across multiple sequencing runs/libraries for the same biological sample so nf-core concatenates them.
sample.validation_hints: No commas; spaces are converted to underscores; keep identical across lanes/reruns of the same sample.

fastq_1.description: Full path to read 1 FASTQ file.
fastq_1.validation_hints: Use gzipped FASTQ; absolute path recommended; for resequencing, create another row with the same sample and different FASTQ path.

fastq_2.description: Full path to read 2 FASTQ file.
fastq_2.validation_hints: Should pair with fastq_1 and only differ by R1/R2 in standard paired-read data.

expected_cells.position_rule: May appear after the first 3 columns
expected_cells.description: Expected total number of cells for a sample.
expected_cells.validation_hints: If repeated rows exist for the same sample, keep the same expected_cells value on each row. Supported by Alevin-fry, STARsolo, and Cellranger; since Cellranger v7 it is usually not recommended.

seq_center.position_rule: May appear after the first 3 columns
seq_center.validation_hints: If repeated rows exist for the same sample, keep the same string for all rows. Used for STARsolo BAM outputs only and overrides params.seq_center.

feature_type.allowed_values: gex | vdj | ab | crispr | cmo | beam
feature_type.description: Feature Barcode technology type for cellranger-multi input rows.
feature_type.validation_hints: Use the same sample name across rows that belong to the same physical sample. beam is currently not supported. For multiplexed FFPE/CMO/OCM data, a second barcodes CSV is also needed.

sample_type.description: Data type for Cell Ranger ARC rows.
sample_type.validation_hints: Required only for cellranger-arc. scRNA rows use gex; scATAC rows use atac. Keep scRNA and scATAC file groups distinguishable.

fastq_barcode.description: Barcode FASTQ path used by Cell Ranger ARC, typically for scATAC rows.
fastq_barcode.validation_hints: Populate for atac rows; leave blank for gex rows. Confirm which file is the barcode FASTQ (often I2) before mapping.

batch.position_rule: Optional extra context column after official columns
batch.description: Extra context for downstream grouping / design metadata. Not an official nf-core field.
batch.validation_hints: Keep only in context templates or strip before strict pipeline submission if needed.

condition.position_rule: Optional extra context column after official columns
condition.description: Experimental condition for LLM processing or later design generation. Not an official nf-core field.
condition.validation_hints: Useful for design matrices / metadata joins; may need to be removed from final strict pipeline input.

cellranger_multi_barcodes.description: Companion CSV required for multiplexed cellranger-multi workflows (CMO/OCM/FFPE-style demultiplexing).

sample.description: Physical sample identifier matching the main samplesheet sample column.
sample.validation_hints: Must match a sample value from the main samplesheet.

multiplexed_sample_id.description: ID for the demultiplexed logical sample within a multiplexed physical sample.
multiplexed_sample_id.validation_hints: Should be unique within the barcodes sheet.

probe_barcode_ids.description: Probe barcode IDs for multiplexed FFPE workflows, when applicable.
probe_barcode_ids.validation_hints: Leave blank unless using probe barcodes.

cmo_ids.description: CMO barcode IDs for Cell Multiplexing Oligo workflows.
cmo_ids.validation_hints: Leave blank unless using CMO multiplexing.

ocm_ids.description: OCM barcode IDs for OCM workflows.
ocm_ids.validation_hints: Leave blank unless using OCM multiplexing.

description.description: Human-readable description of the multiplexed sample.
description.validation_hints: Useful label for LLMs and QC reports.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Use this file as the single context specification for constructing nf-core/scrnaseq input file(s) from already-scraped study metadata.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the upstream agent identifies report_writing mode and chooses NFCORE:scRNAseq as the report type.
report_writer_guidance.output_expectation: Populate the main samplesheet_template and, when needed, also populate the cellranger_multi_barcodes_template companion CSV.
mode_selection_guidance: Use standard mode for ordinary paired FASTQ scRNA-seq inputs.
Use cellranger_multi mode when the study clearly includes multiple feature types for the same physical sample, such as gex plus cmo, vdj, ab, or crispr.
Use cellranger_arc mode when the study clearly includes paired gene expression and ATAC data for the same sample.
population_priority: Assign one logical sample identifier per biological sample or physical sample as appropriate for the selected mode.
Map read 1 FASTQ files to fastq_1 and read 2 FASTQ files to fastq_2 using file naming or explicit mate metadata.
For multiple lanes or resequenced runs from the same sample, repeat the same sample value across rows and change only the FASTQ paths.
Populate feature_type only for cellranger_multi rows.
Populate sample_type and fastq_barcode only for cellranger_arc rows, with fastq_barcode typically used for ATAC rows.
Leave expected_cells blank unless it is explicitly known.
Treat protocol or chemistry as a pipeline parameter suggestion, not as a required samplesheet column.
final_checks: Column order starts with: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2.
Conditional columns are only used when the selected mode requires them.
feature_type values are limited to: gex, vdj, ab, crispr, cmo, beam.
sample_type values are limited to: gex, atac.
The companion barcodes CSV is produced only when multiplexed workflows require it.
